metadata.description:
Amana Colonies Golf Course opened for play in 1989, and has been masterfully designed to preserve the natural features of the land. Our 18-hole championship golf course winds through 300 acres of stately white oak trees and forests. 
The golf course features meandering streams, shining ponds, and striking scenery that add to the aesthetic beauty and enjoyment of the game. The golf course also features lush, watered bentgrass fairways, tees and greens, and strategically placed sand bunkers which come into play on many holes. The golf course offers 5 sets of tees, ranging from 5,228 to 6,824 yards, designed to accommodate players of all skill levels. Many of our guests describe the course as "beautiful, breathtaking, charming, enjoyable, playable, tough, and intimidating."

metadata.description:
Rediscover the beauty of nature and join us for a scenic and relaxing round of golf.

River Valley Golf Course is open to the public and offers 18 challenging holes, Par 72, overlooking the Raccoon River Valley. Hole # 12 is a beautiful Island Green.

You will find us just 15 minutes west of Des Moines. Take Interstate 80 west to the Adel-Desoto exit, go north 8 miles on the west side. Or take Interstate 35-80 to the Hwy 141 exit north to Grimes Hwy 44 exit. Go west to the intersection of Hwy 44 & 169, turn south 2 miles, on the west side.
